evidence.reason: The retry count is computed from input.row before the idempotence check, and effectiveAction is included in the token/sourceKey. When a needs-retriage write updates row.previous_event_id and the same outcome is planned again, the newly recorded event can be counted; at the retry boundary this flips effectiveAction to needs-human, changes sourceKey, and bypasses the already-recorded check, writing a second finding-event for the same outcome. This is an internal idempotence defect in existing behavior.
